metadataRaw.title: How to Self Pop Your WHOLE BACK for Instant Pain Relief
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to self pop your whole back for INSTANT PAIN RELIEF!

This video will be broken into an EASY step-by-step guide that will show exercises to self mobilize, release, or pop the full back -- from the base of the neck all the way to the tailbone.

They'll focus on improving mobility throughout the whole back, which may lead to LESS PAIN, tightness, and better range of motion in the spine. 

As a bonus, these back stretching exercises can be done at home or work, pretty much ANYPLACE and ANYTIME! That way you'll be able to relieve pain and tightness in the full back QUICKLY, and get the pop or release you're looking for.

Watch now and safely pop your whole back at home for quick relief! 

CHAPTERS:
0:00 Intro
0:39 Base of Neck
3:12 Upper and Middle Back
8:01 Lower Back
10:26 Pelvis and SI Joints
